title: Bull Dash
description: Double-tap (or Space) to dash a short way with a dust trail, about every 4 s: a sidestep for a rug puller's dash, and rug pullers ended 36% of yesterday's runs.

title: Bear Flag
description: A new bear carrying a red flag: while it lives, every bear near it runs 30% faster, so you have to cut through the crowd to take it down first.

title: Fear & Greed Meter
description: A gauge at the top fills as you kill; at Extreme Greed, for 10 s you deal double damage, bears pour in 50% faster, and the screen goes gold.
